title: termal_read_mailbox_message returns 404 "native mailbox home membership not found" for a sender's own message on a native relay
outcome: A sender that got a receipt for a message on a native relay mailbox can read that message's current delivery status by its exact message id, as the receipt note tells it to, or gets a typed answer saying why not.
acceptance: For a message sent on a native relay mailbox, termal_read_mailbox_message with the exact returned messageId returns its current status to the sender, or a typed refusal naming the cause and the supported alternative, not a bare 404.
A test covers the sender's own read on a relay message, and the receipt note's advice matches what the call actually supports.
